slots.name: U.S. business share
slots.sentence: With half of its business coming from the United States, the company is now considering a move south.

slots.name: American standards share
slots.sentence: Northern Cables normally divides production of its armored electrical cables — which power everything from office towers to underground mines — evenly between Canadian and American customers.

slots.sentence: Northern Cables, which has 320 employees, is not alone.
